name: @builderforce/agent-loop
description: THE agent loop — the one model→tools→model iteration every BuilderForce surface drives. Owns the step budget, cancellation, argument parsing, assistant/tool message pushing and the finish / ask_human control signals; every surface supplies its model call, its tool dispatch and its hooks. Zero dependencies and no Node builtins: imported by the Worker (cloud), the browser (Brain + Canvas), Node (agent-runtime) and the VS Code extension host.
